text:
Maya: Quick sync re: AltitudePartner metering. They want per-device hourly exports + one reconciled daily CSV. Proposal: Redwood streams signed hourly files and keeps canonical hourly aggregates for audits.
Luca: Which side is authoritative for billing disputes? They prefer partner files to be customer-facing source, Redwood keeps audit copy.
Priya: Ops notes: require event_id + event_ts for every incoming event. Stream to S3 multipart to avoid buffering. Shard by org_id+region.
Dan: Add a 2-minute clock-skew grace when bucketing. Flag events in grace window.
Maya: Draft hourly payload example:
```json
{"snapshot_hour":"2026-04-05T10:00:00Z","region":"us-west-2","rows":[{"device_id":"alt-900","units":456}],"snapshot_id":"alt_snap_20260405_10_uw2_01"}
```
Priya: Security: use X-Redwood-Signature HMAC-SHA256 and require replay protection (event_id dedupe). Keep raw_event_payload 30d.
Luca: Reconciliation SQL to find deltas:
```sql
SELECT p.device_id,p.units AS partner_units,r.units AS redwood_units,(p.units-COALESCE(r.units,0)) AS delta
FROM partner_hourly p
LEFT JOIN redwood_hourly r ON p.device_id=r.device_id AND p.snapshot_hour=r.snapshot_hour
WHERE ABS(p.units-COALESCE(r.units,0))>0;
```
Maya: Action items: Priya implement signed push + streaming S3 writer (due Apr 10); Luca define dispute thresholds & credits policy (due Apr 12); Dan produce timezone normalization doc (due Apr 7).
ingest-bot: TEST: pushed hourly file to altitude-staging (200 OK) snapshot_id=alt_snap_20260405_10_uw2_01
Dan: We'll include a nightly E2E that validates signature, sample rows, and reconciliation output.
Maya: I'll assemble partner spec and runbook, then loop legal for contract language on 24h reconciliation window. Thanks.
